title: Quarterly engagement outline — Northbridge Finance (Q1 renewal prep)
summary: Working draft for the upcoming QBR with Northbridge Finance — focused on renewal preparation for their Dedicated + Private deployment, risk mitigation plan for model latency regressions, and a compact slide deck and ask list for the executive meeting. This file is intended to be a single-sheet narrative and playbook we can hand off to AE + SE for final rehearsals.
objectives: Reinforce value: show cost-per-query improvements and latency stability over the last 6 months
Secure verbal renewal commitment / identify timeline for contract extension (target: signed by end of Q2)
Agree on two technical mitigations for the observed p95 tail spikes and an owners-driven remediations plan
Obtain buy-in for pilot of Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization + batch tuning) on 2 high-volume endpoints
attendees: Michael Yates — Head of ML Platforms, Northbridge
Sana Iqbal — Director, Fraud Ops, Northbridge
slide_outline: 1. Welcome & Agenda — 1 min (Jared) — set expectations: 30-minute exec + 15-minute tech deep-dive
2. Partnership highlights — 2 slides (Elena) — adoption milestones, win stories from Fraud Ops
3. Usage & economics snapshot — 2 slides (Jared) — tokens/day, cost-per-1M-tokens, spend trend vs. forecast
4. Performance & reliability — 2 slides (Luis) — latency p50/p95, incident summary, SLO attainment
5. Risk areas & mitigation plan — 1 slide (Priya) — tail latency, KV cache warmup, autoscale thresholds
6. Redwood Optimize proposal — 1 slide (Priya) — expected savings and quality guardrails
7. Renewal proposal & timeline — 1 slide (Elena) — commercial options: 12/24 month, reserved capacity tiers
8. Ask & next steps — 1 slide (Jared) — decisions requested, owners, and dates
talking_points: Open: thank you for the partnership; highlight how Redwood helped Northbridge reduce per-query cost by ~22% on their fraud-detector endpoint since Oct 2025.
Usage: call out 3 high-volume routes (fraud-detector, onboarding-chat, name-normalize) and that 68% of tokens are from fraud-detector during peak windows.

Performance: acknowledge p95 spikes in late Jan/early Feb — explain root-cause hypothesis (cache cold-start after nightly autoscale purge) and quick wins implemented (sticky-prefetch + adjusted warmup).
Reliability: confirm SLOs (99.5% p99 response < 600ms for priority endpoints) and current attainment (99.3%) — propose targeted A/B rollout of batching profile to hit 99.6%.
Optimize ask: request permission to run a 4-week Optimize pilot on the fraud-detector route (non-prod then canary prod), expected cost reduction 15–25% and <0.5% quality delta via eval harness.
Commercial: propose 12-month Reserved Dedicated with a 10% uplift on current commit in exchange for priority capacity and 4-week rollback SLA for model changes.
Decision request: Would Northbridge agree to a pilot start in 2 weeks and an IOI (intent to renew) by the end of the next month?
metrics_snapshot: Current snapshot (rolling 30d): avg tokens/day 42.3M; peak qps 820; p50 latency 78ms; p95 latency 380ms; p99 latency 920ms; uptime 99.92%; monthly spend $86.2k; top 3 endpoints by tokens: fraud-detector (68%), onboarding-chat (18%), normalize-name (6%).
renewal_tracker_notes: Northbridge contract renewal window: renewal notice due 2026-06-30. Current contract term ends 2026-09-30. Recommended cadence: exec QBR (this doc) -> commercial proposal sent within 10 business days -> AE to secure LOI by 2026-04-30 -> formal contract negotiation May-June. Consider 24-month discount tier only if they commit to Reserved Dedicated capacity + 1 compliance add-on (audit retention).
risks_and_actions: Risk: p99 tail spikes could cause feature regressions during fraud ops peak. Action: SE (Priya) to implement sticky-prefetch and measure in staging by 2026-03-20.
Risk: customer hesitation on reserved commitment. Action: AE (Elena) to prepare two commercial scenarios (12mo/24mo) and run ROI model comparing on-demand vs reserved by 2026-03-25.

Risk: quality regression from quantization pilot. Action: Research (Tom Becker) to run evaluation harness with existing prompt-set and provide acceptance criteria prior to canary (deliverable 2026-04-01).
Risk: security checklist for Private deployment changes. Action: SRE (Luis) & Security to produce short checklist and timeboxed maintenance window proposal (due 2026-03-22).
